profile.name: Prasad Pawar
profile.role: Senior Lead Developer · Angular • React • Node.js • MongoDB
profile.summary:
I'm a Senior Lead Developer with 8+ years of experience building scalable, high-performance enterprise web applications with Angular, React, Node.js, Express.js and MongoDB. I specialise in frontend architecture, performance optimisation and leading engineering teams through complex enterprise delivery — I currently lead a team of 8 developers at a global financial technology company.

Some highlights:

- Improved UI performance of enterprise Angular applications by 35–40% through lazy loading, code splitting and change-detection optimisation.
- Built reusable component libraries that sped up development by 30%+ across multiple teams.
- Designed RESTful APIs with Node.js and Express.js for high-volume data processing.
- Implemented security best practices against XSS and CSRF, with secure API communication for enterprise compliance.
- Led a greenfield enterprise platform from concept to production, achieving strong user adoption.

I'm open to relocating to Dubai (UAE) or Germany.

highlights: Lead a cross-functional team of 8 developers delivering enterprise-grade financial services applications.
Architected a greenfield enterprise platform from concept through production, achieving strong user adoption.

Designed a scalable Angular architecture and reusable design systems adopted across multiple product lines.
Optimised REST APIs and MongoDB query performance for high-traffic fleet tracking platforms.
Mentored developers on best practices and served as the primary technical point of contact for clients.
Developed and maintained enterprise web applications on the MEAN stack.
Contributed to Apple News research initiatives and built solutions on the BigBlueButton platform.
Participated in code reviews and modernised legacy Angular applications to support product growth.
Built custom web applications with MongoDB, Express.js, Angular and Node.js to meet client needs.
Worked closely with clients to understand requirements and deliver tailored solutions.
Delivered within project timelines and budgets, and provided ongoing support and maintenance.
